snippet.title: Slot or Die - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Slot or Die drops you into a cursed castle where a lone knight must confront ancient horror with a relic that doubles as a slot machine. Stop the reels to chain attacks, trigger bonuses and manage scarce inventory in a tense roguelite where every spin decides your fate.
